title: HW↔FW-001: Sensor Buses (I2C/ADC/1-Wire) + GPIO + Bring-Up DoD
description: Hardware provides schematics, pin-mux assignments, sensor specs, and board errata; Firmware returns bring-up results and driver/electrical findings. Includes the joint Bring-Up Definition of Done. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2 (Hardware Engineer) and the Shared Bring-Up DoD.

bring_up_dod.description: Joint Bring-Up Definition of Done; both HW and FW must sign. Items not passing block Development exit.

power_rails_within_5pct.description: All voltages within ±5% of nominal, ripple in spec, sequencing confirmed.

clocks_locked.description: Oscillator stable, PLLs locked, peripheral clocks verified.

reset_boot_ok.description: Reset vector confirmed, boot to firmware entry, watchdog operational.

buses_enumerated.description: I2C scan, SPI loopback, UART TX/RX confirmed.

power_budget_met.description: Measured active/sleep current within the Architect's power budget.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine pin-mux/sensor-spec interpretation and bring-up. Platform/peripheral re-selection escalates to Tier-1 (platform change).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (joint board bring-up; errata triage; schematic/layout review)
confirm_conditions: every pin_mux entry has signal, pin, and a valid function
every sensor has a bus and sampling_rate_hz; I2C sensors have a valid i2c_address
bring_up_dod: all 7 technical items true AND signed_by_hw AND signed_by_fw
reject_conditions: any bring_up_dod technical item false (blocks Development exit)
two sensors assigned conflicting pins/addresses (pin-mux conflict)
counter_conditions: errata reported without a workaround on a critical signal — request triage/workaround
sensor sampling_rate_hz exceeds a documented bus bandwidth — request rate/bus reconciliation
